My daily study allowance is 55 minutes maximum, not 55 minutes per topic.", "reference_date": "2027-02-01", "user_control": "continue", "clarifications": [{"field_id": "deadline", "question": "What is the last date available for study, inclusive?", "status": "available", "answer_text": "Keep the timetable within the window ending 2027-02-04, with the end date included."}], "field_values": {"deadline": "Keep the timetable within the window ending 2027-02-04, with the end date included.", "available_time": "My daily study allowance is 55 minutes maximum, not 55 minutes per topic.", "topics": "I am reviewing lesson diagrams about laminated pastry.\nArrange the preparation as a few study sessions.", "priorities": null}, "eligible_fields": ["priorities"], "remaining_question_items": 2, "fields": [{"field_id": "deadline", "label_zh": "截止日", "description_zh": "最后可学习日期，包含当日。起始日始终在初始请求给定。", "question_template": "What is the last date available for study, inclusive?"}, {"field_id": "available_time", "label_zh": "每日时长", "description_zh": "每天可学习的分钟上限。本试跑采用统一每日上限。", "question_template": "How many minutes can you study per day at most?"}, {"field_id": "topics", "label_zh": "学习主题", "description_zh": "主题名称与覆盖要求，可含每个主题的最低总分钟数。", "question_template": "Which topics must be covered, and are there minimum minutes for each?"}, {"field_id": "priorities", "label_zh": "优先要求", "description_zh": "优先主题及相关硬性时长，或明确无偏好；软偏好不自动计分。", "question_template": "Do you have topic priorities or additional minimum-time requirements?"}]}
